objective: Sign in and sign out with a synthetic active role user.
preconditions: Pilot tenant seeded; local server running.
testData: A pilot.example.test role address; local synthetic password supplied out-of-band.
steps: Sign in through the labelled Company, Email and Password fields.
Confirm the role-appropriate dashboard.
Sign out and revisit a protected URL.
expectedResult: The session is created securely, the correct tenant/role is shown, and the signed-out request returns to login.

objective: Verify generic invalid-login handling and bounded lockout.
testData: Synthetic address and deliberately incorrect password.
steps: Submit invalid credentials repeatedly within the documented bound.
Observe the generic response and throttled state.
Wait for/reset only under the local test procedure.
expectedResult: No account-existence detail or secret is exposed; the local identity/IP throttle activates and valid unrelated users remain unaffected.

objective: Confirm least-privilege pilot role assignments.
preconditions: All ten pilot role users exist.
steps: Open Users.
Inspect each synthetic user and role.
Attempt one action documented as forbidden for Dispatch and Gate Security.
expectedResult: Assignments match the matrix and forbidden actions are absent or return 403 server-side.

objective: Review the two-site, four-gate pilot configuration.
testData: Synthetic North Logistics Hub and Synthetic Service and Returns Yard.
steps: Open Organisation.
Inspect sites, addresses, directions and archived state.
Verify a Gate Security user cannot edit them.
expectedResult: Only synthetic sites/gates appear; directions are correct and configuration remains administrator-only.

objective: Verify the 15 synthetic vehicles, trailers and driver assignments.
testData: SYN-FLT-001 through SYN-FLT-015 and Synthetic Driver 01–15.
steps: Open vehicle and driver lists.
Inspect a van, truck, trailer and unavailable-tracker vehicle.
Confirm all visible identifiers say synthetic.
expectedResult: Counts and assignments match verification; no record resembles a real person or asset.

objective: Verify synthetic driver and vehicle documents and expiry state.
steps: Open driver and vehicle detail.
Inspect document type, issuer, expiry and verification.
Confirm no real attachment is implied.
expectedResult: All records are verified synthetic metadata with future dates and no external document content.

objective: Create and submit a normal synthetic dispatch.
steps: Create a delivery movement.
Add expected return, distance, sender, recipient and cargo.
Submit for approval.
expectedResult: Movement becomes SUBMITTED, immutable reference is visible, and Dispatch cannot approve it.

objective: Independently approve a submitted movement and prevent self-approval.
steps: Review driver, vehicle, documents and purpose.
Approve with a reason.
Attempt requester self-approval through the API.
expectedResult: Independent approval succeeds; requester self-approval or missing permission returns 403 and is not applied.

objective: Complete verified exit with a passing inspection and synthetic evidence.
preconditions: Approved movement at Synthetic North Main Gate.
steps: Find the approved movement.
Start exit and record synthetic manual identity verification.
Complete required inspection items, attach synthetic evidence and clear/complete.
expectedResult: Exit is recorded once, evidence is private/checksummed, and movement becomes in progress.

objective: Record on-time return and complete a no-discrepancy reconciliation.
testData: Matching synthetic odometer, fuel, cargo and condition.
steps: Start entry for the movement.
Record return readings and passing checks.
Clear and complete the event.
Open reconciliation.
expectedResult: One return is recorded, reconciliation is NO_DISCREPANCIES and movement closes without exception.

objective: Block gate processing for an unapproved movement.
steps: Search for SYNPILOT009.
Attempt to start/clear a gate event.
Inspect safe API response and audit trail.
expectedResult: The action is blocked without creating a clearance; error is safe and relevant audit history remains.

objective: Deny or hold a vehicle after a safety-condition failure.
role: Gate Security Officer and Approving Manager
testData: Synthetic tyre-sidewall defect and text evidence.
steps: Inspect the failed condition item.
Confirm evidence and compulsory supervisor route.
Verify vehicle workshop lockout and authorised corrective-action visibility.
expectedResult: Failure/evidence is preserved, officer cannot self-resolve, denial/hold is visible and no accusation is generated.

objective: Review cargo, fuel and odometer discrepancies neutrally.
steps: Open each reconciliation.
Compare departure/return values and source quality.
Record a human explanation/corrective action for one discrepancy.
expectedResult: Differences and linked exceptions are factual; no guilt/fraud conclusion is automatic and unrelated customer data is absent.

objective: Verify compulsory reason, independent review and chronology for a gate override.
steps: Inspect the gate decision reason.
Attempt an override without reason in a new local fixture.
Review audit chronology and repeated-override indicator.
expectedResult: Reasonless override is rejected; authorised override is attributed and preserved; indicator is explainable only.

objective: Distinguish current mock, stale and unavailable tracker data.
preconditions: Synthetic tracker fixtures seeded; no external provider.
steps: Inspect source and freshness for each vehicle.
Review manual confirmation for unavailable tracker.
Confirm route deviation is not invented.
expectedResult: Data is labelled MOCK/MANUAL/UNAVAILABLE or stale; missing data is never treated as misconduct proof.

objective: Review, dismiss/reopen and escalate explainable indicators.
testData: Late, override, tracker-unavailable and cargo indicators.
steps: Inspect explanation, rule snapshot, source quality and supporting records.
Record review/dismiss/reopen chronology on a local case.
Escalate one indicator to an investigation.
expectedResult: Every transition is append-only and human-attributed; escalation is tenant-scoped and no automated finding occurs.

objective: Exercise independently approved investigation lifecycle.
role: Internal Investigator / Auditor and Approving Manager
preconditions: Synthetic exception available; separate role users signed in.
testData: Synthetic evidence, witness response and neutral finding.
steps: Refer, triage, assign and begin.
Add party response, notes, task and held evidence.
Draft and submit finding.
Prove self-approval fails, approve independently, report and close.
expectedResult: Chronology is complete, response retained, self-approval 403, report private and closed outcome based only on approved finding.

objective: Prevent deletion while investigation hold is active.
preconditions: Closed synthetic case retains active hold.
steps: Request deletion of held evidence.
Confirm rejection.
Attempt hold release without authority or required second approval.
Inspect chronology.
expectedResult: Deletion and unauthorised release fail; evidence and immutable chronology remain.

objective: Verify case-specific, time-limited access and immediate revocation.
testData: Closed case plus unrelated highly restricted case.
steps: Sign in as external auditor and open assigned case.
Attempt unrelated case URL/API and internal mutation.
Revoke grant as administrator and retry assigned case.
expectedResult: Only permitted case/material is visible; restricted note is hidden; mutation/foreign case returns 403/404; revocation takes immediate effect.

objective: Generate private case/analytics reports and formula-safe CSV.
steps: Generate case and analytics PDF reports.
Download through signed routes.
Export filtered CSV and inspect formula neutralisation and disclaimers.
expectedResult: Files contain only permitted synthetic data, quality/human-review notices and expiring private access.

objective: Represent billing degradation without payment or data loss.
preconditions: Pilot subscription is PAST_DUE and provider mock-only.
steps: Open billing overview.
Confirm warning and retained tenant data.
Verify production mock-success controls and do not initiate payment.
expectedResult: Past-due state is clear; existing safety workflows/data remain; no real payment or delivery occurs.

objective: Inspect tenant, storage, support and provider readiness without secret exposure.
preconditions: Platform admin and pilot tenant seeded.
steps: Open production readiness and linked operational dashboards.
Inspect job/provider/storage/tenant states.
Verify an ordinary pilot user receives 403 for diagnostics.
expectedResult: Blockers are accurate, providers disabled, no secret/customer content exposed and no external connection button exists.

objective: Reject cross-tenant URL, API and identifier manipulation.
preconditions: Pilot and acme-logistics synthetic tenants exist.
testData: Foreign vehicle, movement, indicator, case and media IDs.
steps: Request each foreign identifier through page and API routes.
Attempt a foreign ID in a create/update payload.
Inspect response body for leaked data.
expectedResult: Every access fails safely with 403/404; no foreign field, count, stack or secret is disclosed.

objective: Complete critical gate screens at phone and tablet sizes.
preconditions: Synthetic approved movement; fake camera/file fallback available.
steps: Sign in and navigate at each viewport.
Inspect queue, event, checklist, evidence controls and errors.
Use keyboard and touch-size checks.
expectedResult: No horizontal page overflow, clipped action or inaccessible control; fallback is honest and safe.

objective: Verify keyboard, names, headings, focus and status semantics on critical pages.
testData: Login, gate, analytics, investigation and readiness pages.
steps: Navigate with Tab/Shift+Tab and activate controls with keyboard.
Inspect visible focus, labelled inputs, heading sequence and table headers.
Trigger errors/status and verify role/alert/status announcement.
expectedResult: Critical controls have accessible names/focus, errors are announced, severity is textual and colour is not the only cue.

objective: State and verify the current online-only boundary.
preconditions: Gate page loaded; browser network can be disabled.
steps: Disable network before a mutation.
Attempt a gate or evidence action.
Restore network and reload/reconcile state before retry.
expectedResult: No false success is shown, no offline capability is claimed, and reconnection reloads authoritative server state before a safe retry.

objective: Rehearse local backup restore and rollback decision.
preconditions: Local test database; no external systems.
testData: Synthetic pilot tenant and committed release candidate.
steps: Run guarded backup/restore verification.
Verify migration history and pilot counts.
Walk through rollback triggers, incident owner placeholders and customer communication boundary.
expectedResult: Isolated restore passes, production-like targets are refused, and rollback requires named owners/approval without destructive improvisation.
